ticket.subject: Performance problem for all users
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

I look after our account at Larkspur Labs. Since 14:50 UTC the whole app has been extremely slow for everyone at Larkspur Labs: pages take more than 30 seconds to load.

We can still work, but very slowly. People at other companies are posting about the same thing. This has already cost us a morning of work.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Please look into it.

Regards,
Mateo

label_notes: clean outage (outage-slow): the whole service is degraded for many users but still usable, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
